name: jianji
description: 简辑：Ubuntu 本地批量视频编辑器

scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && JIANJI_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && esbuild src/main/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist-electron/main.cjs && esbuild src/main/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist-electron/preload.cjs
scripts.package: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb
